科研.title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26887v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports as its data source, Navalia semantically selects supporting evidence from complete fact sets and constructs executable computation chains to generate analytical tasks with traceable evidence and actual data dependencies between steps. We further use independent LLM review and programmatic checks to verify evidence consistency and answer correctness. The verified tasks are then used for trajectory collection, cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) to improve long-horizon task execution. Navalia, initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, achieves consistent gains over the base model across all five benchmarks: OfficeQA Pro, FinSearchComp, Finance Agent Benchmark, APEX-Agents-AA, and Workspace-Bench-Lite. These results demonstrate that Navalia improves evidence integration, tool use, and long-horizon task execution capabilities and generalizes to broader Cowork settings, including general office tasks.

科研.title: Large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction and progress updates
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Due to the rapid growth of the global population, traditional construction methods are gradually unable to meet the current housing demand. The advancement of machine learning algorithms has encouraged researchers to explore their applications in the construction industry, leading to more intelligent and efficient building processes. In particular, the rise of large language models in recent years has provided more possibilities for the transformation from traditional construction to smart construction. In this study, a large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction method is proposed. An enhanced soft actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithm is developed to plan actions for a mobile crane according to construction tasks. Robot kinematics and control algorithms are used to ensure that the actions generated by the reinforcement learning algorithm can be executed by the crane. In addition, a customized embedding model is developed to extract information from the construction environment according to user interests. Then, a large language model, ChatGPT 5, is used to update construction progress, provide safety information to control system, and generate construction progress reports. The feasibility of proposed method is verified through several full-scall retaining wall construction experiments.

科研.title: Pareto-Optimal RTL Code Generation via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Models
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent studies have proposed reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods that enable LLMs to generate high-quality RTL circuits from natural-language specifications. Existing approaches optimize circuit PPA (Power, Performance, Area) by aggregating multiple objectives into a single scalar reward, making it difficult to simultaneously generate diverse Pareto-optimal solutions across different trade-offs such as low power, low latency, and small area. However, in practical design, the relative importance of each objective varies depending on product requirements and design constraints; thus, obtaining a diverse and high-quality candidate set is beneficial in that designers can choose a preferred trade-off a posteriori. In this work, we are the first to propose a learning method for LLM-based circuit generation that optimizes, not the quality of a single circuit, but the quality and diversity of the entire circuit set obtained through multiple generations in the PPA objective space. The proposed method consists of (1) a generation-based training pipeline that reformulates coverage improvement of the entire Pareto solution set into a sequential circuit generation problem, and (2) a reward function based on Hypervolume Contribution (HVC) that measures how much a generated circuit contributes to the Pareto front. Evaluation on the RTLLM v2 benchmark shows that the proposed method achieves +13.3 percentage points in relative Hypervolume over a baseline without PPA optimization and +14.4 percentage points over a single-objective reinforcement learning method, while also demonstrating superiority in circuit diversity.

科研.title: MedPAO-Assist: Edge-Deployable, Modality-Aware Agentic AI for Radiology Report Structuring
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.26913v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The adoption of Large Language Models for radiology report structuring has been largely dominated by either proprietary cloud-based models or large open models requiring high-end GPUs for deployment, which is a critical bottleneck for clinical adoption in radiology workflows that demand data privacy and offline operation. To address this, we present MedPAO-Assist, an edge-deployable agentic framework that generates structured radiology reports directly from radiologist dictation and voice commands, requiring only $\approx3.3$ GB peak RAM and achieving an average end-to-end latency of $\approx31$ seconds on a standard laptop CPU through an asynchronous, multi-threaded execution pipeline. The system currently supports four major imaging modalities -- Chest X-ray, Chest CT, Abdomen CT, and Brain MRI. To our knowledge, it is among the earliest agentic systems to run its entire pipeline with a Small Language Model (SLM) in the 0.6B-parameter range. This multi-agent architecture, built around an Extract-Ground-Generate paradigm, performs concept extraction, SNOMED-CT grounding, and structured report generation, followed by a speech-driven human-in-the-loop correction phase, together forming a fully "no-touch" reporting workflow that requires no keyboard input, external API calls, or internet connectivity. We evaluate each pipeline stage individually -- concept extraction, ontology grounding, and concept categorization and report hardware profiling results demonstrating the system's feasibility for real-time, CPU-only clinical deployment.

科研.title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Threshold Controller (\textsc{ATC}) that adjusts admission thresholds online from observed hit rates and memory pressure. We integrate KVLearn into a globally disaggregated serving topology and evaluate it on text and multimodal workloads, including large image/video-derived \textsc{KV} blocks with heterogeneous reuse patterns. KVLearn reduces end-to-end time-to-first-token by up to 56% versus No-Cache, 38% versus LRU-Pool, and 33% versus Mooncake-style baselines, while cutting inter-node \textsc{KV} transfer volume by up to 53% versus LRU-Pool. On MM-Session, throughput remains within ${\sim}5%$ of oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn.

科研.title: Interaction-Gated Time-Frequency Learning for Parameter-Efficient PPG-Based Heart Rate Estimation
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost and non-invasive heart rate (HR) monitoring but remains sensitive to waveform distortion, physiological variability, and measurement interference. Temporal waveform characteristics and frequency-domain periodicity provide complementary information for HR estimation; however, effectively exploring and integrating these representations within a compact model remains challenging. This paper proposes TF-IG, a parameter-efficient interaction-gated time-frequency learning framework for PPG-based HR estimation. TF-IG employs a dual-branch architecture in which a temporal branch captures pulse morphology via dilated depthwise-separable convolutions, while a frequency branch extracts cardiac periodicity information from bounded log-spectrogram representations. To combine the two domains, we introduce an interaction-gated fusion module that explicitly models feature agreement and discrepancy, while also learning feature-wise weights to balance temporal and spectral information. A parameter-shared regression head further maps the temporal, spectral, and fused representations into the final HR prediction space. Experiments on the benchmark BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset using a subject-exclusive training, validation, and test protocol show that TF-IG achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.227 BPM, a root mean square error (RMSE) of 2.060 BPM, a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9934, and 92.28 percent of estimates within 3 BPM, while remaining parameter-efficient with only 84.6K parameters. Ablation results further demonstrate the complementary contributions of the temporal and frequency branches, interaction-gated fusion, and shared regression head. These results indicate that explicitly modeling cross-domain interactions provides an effective accuracy-complexity trade-off for lightweight PPG-based HR estimation.

科研.title: Reinforcement learning for hardware acceleration and system-level optimization on FPGA and integrated-circuit platforms: A survey
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables adaptive and autonomous decision-making in embedded, edge, and heterogeneous computing systems. Field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and integrated circuits (ICs) offer low latency, energy efficiency, and architectural flexibility for RL deployment, while introducing challenges in resource constraints, implementation complexity, and hardware-algorithm co-design. This review surveys more than 100 studies on RL implementations across FPGA and IC platforms, emphasizing architectures, implementation strategies, performance evaluation, and applications. The literature is organized by RL family, including model-based Markov decision processes, classical value-based methods, deep RL, actor-critic, policy-gradient, and multi-agent approaches. We further classify studies by abstraction level, hardware realization strategy, and application domain, examining how RL algorithms map onto reconfigurable and fixed hardware. Unlike surveys restricted to particular algorithms or platforms, this work provides a unified analysis of FPGA and IC implementations, covering acceleration, reconfigurable architectures, energy-aware control, and system-level optimization. Comparative assessments consider resource utilization, latency, throughput, power consumption, and reported performance gains. Finally, we identify recurring architectural patterns, practical limitations, open challenges, and research directions for efficient RL-driven hardware systems. The survey offers a consolidated reference for researchers developing and evaluating RL solutions on specialized hardware.

科研.title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28703v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-scale topology optimization (TO) remains computationally demanding, especially for stress-constrained problems. To address this challenge, we propose the simultaneous neural topology optimization (SNTO) framework where we represent state, adjoint, and design variables with custom neural networks (NNs) whose parameters are jointly optimized within a single optimization loop that leverages continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation. This optimization minimizes a multi-component loss function that combines the design objective, an aggregation of the local stress constraints, and the potential energy functionals. Our NNs have a unique architecture that accelerates convergence while enabling the networks to capture sharp gradients and boundaries which are critical to stress-constrained TO. To achieve scalability to millions of degrees of freedom (DoF), we develop a hardware-aware training scheme in which the design domain is partitioned into subdomains that are distributed across multiple GPUs. To control peak GPU memory usage, we further slice each subdomain into smaller regions whose loss gradients are evaluated sequentially and accumulated to update the NN parameters. Unlike domain decomposition approaches, our partitioning naturally ensures field continuity across the subdomains and does not require the introduction of additional terms into the loss function. For validation, we first evaluate the proposed framework on various 2D stress-constrained benchmarks and compare our results to a conventional finite element-based approach, showing that SNTO produces super-resolution designs with sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions. We then consider large-scale 3D problems with up to eight million collocation points and distribute the training over up to eight GPUs.

科研.title: Polymer-Mediated Hotspot Evolution in Shock-Induced Pore Collapse in 1,3,5,7-Tetranitro-1,3,5,7-tetrazocane (HMX)-based Explosives
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The initiation of detonation in high explosives (HEs) under shock loading is strongly influenced by the collapse of porosity and the subsequent formation of hotspots. As these materials are widely integrated with polymer binders to form polymer-bonded explosives, the collapse of pores at explosive-binder interfaces has received significant interest. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed that the shock-driven expansion of soft polymers (e.g. polystyrene) into a void produces greater pressure-volume (PV) work during recompression and higher local temperatures compared to pore collapse in neat HEs, ultimately expediting the onset of chemical reactions. Yet how pore collapse, interfacial phenomena, and binder chemistry jointly affect initiation remains insufficiently understood. We provide deeper insights into the role of polymer in hotspot evolution through reactive MD simulations, specifically characterizing its chemical behavior during the shock-induced collapse of voids at sizes approaching experimentally relevant length scales. We consider the HE 1,3,5,7-Tetranitro-1,3,5,7-tetrazocane (HMX) in a crystal-gap-crystal stack with polystyrene along the upstream surface. In the hydrodynamic collapse regime, hotspots nucleate at the material interfaces, with void length-dependence in PV work, shock temperature, and the onset of self-sustaining chemistry. Driven by shock-induced deformation and HMX decomposition, the binder undergoes backbone chain scission followed by extensive aromatic-backbone cross-bonding, akin to a graphite to diamond transformation. These reactions act as heat sinks, suppressing deflagration and ultimately inhibiting hotspot growth and coalescence between crystals. The simulations further link the polymer's chemical response to the shock-to-detonation transition in polymer-bonded explosives.

科研.title: Paramagnetic phase of MnTe$_2$: complete one phonon Raman spectrum
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study we present a complete first-order Raman scattering spectrum of paramagnetic phase of MnTe$_2$- a material, where new type of spin texture induced by noncoplanar antiferromagnetic ordering below the N\'eel temperature ($T_N \approx 90$ K) gives rise to unconventional scenario of magnetism. Basic properties of all five phonon modes ($A_g$, $E_g$ and three $T_g$) predicted by the group theory have been successfully approached through polarization, excitation and temperature dependent measurements. In particular, the ever-missing phonon mode of $T_g$ symmetry has been unambiguously resolved in the room temperature Raman spectrum at approximately 107 cm$^{-1}$, just 1.5 cm$^{-1}$ higher in frequency compared to the $E_g$ mode. Density functional theory calculations reproduce the observed Raman-active phonon spectrum and support the assignment of all five first-order Raman modes, including the near-degeneracy of the $E_g$ and one of the $T_g$ vibrations. The calculations further reveal a dense manifold of low-energy antiferromagnetic spin configurations, separated from the ground state by only a few meV per formula unit. Furthermore, strong signals of inelastically scattered light from the paramagnetic (PM) phase of MnTe$_2$ were acquired with long wavelength excitations, i.e. 633 nm and 785 nm, revealing the $2A_g$ overtone at approx. 360 cm$^{-1}$. The enhanced absorption of the light in the near infrared range could be a putative reason behind the anomalous angular dependence of scattered intensity of the highest frequency $T_g$ phonon mode (183 cm$^{-1}$) measured in PM MnTe$_2$ with parallelly aligned polarizers. Finally, upon cooling just below the $T_N$, the measured properties of phonons remained basically unperturbed by the incipient long-range antiferromagnetic ordering.

科研.title: Ultrafast and Anisotropic Exciton Transport in Layered NbOI$_2$
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric layered semiconductors provide a unique platform for exploring coupled excitonic and electronic phenomena in reduced dimensions. Here, exciton transport in layered NbOI$_2$ is investigated using transient absorption microscopy. Ultrafast and strongly anisotropic exciton diffusion is observed. The diffusion coefficient of about 160 cm$^2$ s$^{-1}$ along the nonpolar crystal axis is among the highest reported for van der Waals semiconductors. The transport exhibits an approximately twofold in-plane anisotropy between the polar and nonpolar directions, reflecting the intrinsic low-symmetry crystal structure of NbOI$_2$. The environmental stability of NbOI$_2$ is further investigated, and fabrication and encapsulation conditions required to achieve long-term sample stability are identified. These results establish NbOI$_2$ as a promising platform for studying anisotropic exciton transport and highlight the critical role of interface protection in air-sensitive van der Waals materials.

科研.title: Strain-Induced Interfacial Bond Evolution and Facet-dependent Strain Response of Electronic Properties in Oxidized Silicon Nanowires
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon nanowires (Si NWs) have emerged as promising candidates for next-generation nanoelectronic devices due to their tunable electronic properties, and compatibility with aggressive scaling requirements. The integration of strain further enhances their performance by modulating carrier mobility, band structure, and transport behavior without altering material chemistry. Within the NW, the silicon-silicon dioxide (Si-SiO$_{2}$) interface serves as a critical region where strain redistribution and suboxide bonding collectively influence the mechanical and electronic response. Here, we combine reactive force field molecular dynamics and first-principles calculations to investigate how oxidation-induced interfacial structure and crystallographic facet orientation govern strain-dependent bond evolution and facet-dependent strain response of electronic properties in oxidized Si NWs. Simulated dry thermal oxidation generates chemically realistic Si-SiO$_{2}$ interfaces, enabling direct characterization of bond order redistribution and stress gradient development across the interface under tensile strain. Interfacial Si-Si bonds exhibit elongation and reduced bond order associated with partial oxidation states, leading to localized stress concentration and preferential bond rupture. Complementary density functional theory calculations on facet-specific models reveal that orientation-dependent interfacial bonding modulates facet-dependent strain response of electronic properties. Together, these results establish a direct coupling between interfacial suboxide chemistry, mechanical deformation, and electronic structure, providing atomistic insight into strain-modulated behavior at oxidized silicon interfaces in faceted NWs.

科研.title: Comprehensive Acoustic Characterization of a Broadband Lateral MEMS Ultrasonic Transducer by Near-Field Acoustic Holography and Coupled Multiphysics Simulation
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28868v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Broadband airborne ultrasonic transducers are attractive for applications such as ranging, echo-location, and acoustic material characterization, where wide bandwidths enable advanced excitation and signal-processing techniques. Recently, a lateral capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducer (L-CMUT) employing electrostatically actuated in-plane microbeams was introduced as a broadband MEMS transducer concept. However, a comprehensive investigation of its acoustic radiation behavior and quantitative validation of corresponding multiphysics models have not yet been reported. In this work, we present a combined experimental and numerical characterization of a previously reported L-CMUT device operating between 10 kHz and 60 kHz. A coupled electrostatic--structural--thermoviscous finite-element model is combined with an acoustic boundary-element formulation to investigate the complete transduction chain from electrostatic actuation to acoustic radiation. The numerical predictions are validated experimentally using spherical near-field acoustic holography, enabling reconstruction of three-dimensional directivity patterns, radiated acoustic power, and spherical harmonic representations of the radiated sound field. The results show that the broadband behavior originates from strong thermoviscous damping within the narrow beam--stator cavities, resulting in strongly overdamped operation despite a mechanical eigenfrequency near 50 kHz. Good agreement between simulations and measurements is obtained for radiation patterns, radiated sound power, and spherical harmonic content. Furthermore, horn loading primarily redistributes acoustic energy and modifies directivity while only weakly affecting the total radiated acoustic power.

科研.title: Coupled Loop-within-Loop Resonators at the near-field: Extended Bandwidth and Short Pulse Response upon Parametric Conversion
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parametric frequency conversion have seen a renewed interest, specifically in superconducting quantum circuits at GHz range. These nonlinear convertors are typically narrow band and one may wish to extend their frequency range. Here, two coupled resonators are investigated: a loop-within-loop structure, whose gap is coupled by short, a diode, or simply left open. While simulations and experimental results are limited to GHz range, the concept is general. On their own, the loops exhibit natural frequencies of ca, f=1.5 GHz and f/2=0.73 GHz, respectively; the coupling modifies the resonance frequencies and increases its bandwidth. In one example, signal is fed from one loop and is received by the other. In another example, the input signal is provided across a coupling diode and is received by either loops. It is shown that in the case of nonlinear coupling, the frequency bandwidth can be as large as 3 GHz. Such bandwidth is associated with a very narrow temporal response of less than 150 ps, suggesting coherent effects through high-harmonic excitations at the near-field.

科研.title: Cavity optomechanical magnetometer actuated by substrate bending
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.28634v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We describe a magnetic field sensor based on a monolithic Fabry-Perot cavity. The cavities were fabricated in a thin-film buckling process at one surface of a fused silica chip, and the chip was subsequently bonded to a giant magnetostrictive material (GMM). External magnetic fields drive flexural modes of the assembly and the associated bending stresses are efficiently mapped to changes in the cavity height, with enhanced response at kHz-range mechanical resonance frequencies. A key attribute of this platform is that the size of the transducing material is decoupled from the size of the optical cavity. The buckled cavity operates in low mode order and with moderate Q ~ 103, providing a high optomechanical coupling coefficient while also enabling a straightforward tuned-to-slope readout technique. Peak sensitivity ~ 2 pT/Hz1/2 was achieved in an unshielded laboratory environment, limited by laser phase and electronics noise in the readout system. With future reductions in these noise sources, we predict that a broadband thermomechanical-noise-limited sensitivity in the ~ 0.1 pT/Hz1/2 range is feasible.

科研.title: Consistent Modeling of SEI Growth via Electron Diffusion Validated Across Diverse Cell Specifications and Operating Conditions in LFP/Graphite Cells
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.29775v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding and predicting degradation in lithium-ion batteries is critical for their widespread deployment. The continuous growth of the solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) remains a dominant aging pathway, yet accurately modeling its kinetics across diverse cell specifications and operating conditions remains a significant challenge. Here, we present and validate a physically grounded SEI growth model mediated by the electron diffusion mechanism. This framework intrinsically captures the state of charge (SOC) dependence of degradation through the impact of the anode potential on the electron concentration, which governs the rate of SEI growth. The presented model explicitly accounts for variations in electrolyte salt, anode material, temperature, and cycling rate. Validation against experimental aging data for LFP/graphite cells demonstrates high predictive accuracy across a broad range of cell specifications and cycling conditions, including confined SOC windows, electrolyte salts (LiFSI, LiPF6), artificial graphites (AGC, AGD), temperatures (40-70{\deg}C), and C-rates (C/20-1C). Remarkably, a single, consistent set of parameters is applied to simulate the capacity fade for all experiments without recalibration. While quantitative overestimations occur during high-SOC storage periods, the framework consistently captures the observed degradation trends. Our findings underscore that lower SOC operation mitigates degradation, establishing a physics-based model for predicting long-term lithium-ion battery aging.

科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，Polygon 昨日（10 月 21 日）发布博文， 报道称《鬼灭之刃：无限城篇第二章》动画电影可能会在 2027 年 9 月 15 日发行上映。 电影信息网站 The-Numbers.com 近期收录了一部未命名动画电影，由索尼影业与 Crunchyroll 联合发行，定档于 2027 年 9 月 15 日。IT之家附上相关截图如下： 由于索尼及 Crunchyroll 持有《鬼灭之刃》系列的全球发行与流媒体权利，且索尼旗下 Aniplex 也参与该系列制作委员会，不少粉丝推测该神秘电影就是《鬼灭之刃：无限城篇第二章》。 另一个候选者是已宣布将于 2027 年夏季上映的《海贼王剧场版：神之谷》。但该系列由东映动画制作，而上述未命名影片的资料并未提及东映；索尼 / Crunchyroll 虽负责《海贼王》电影在北美的发行，却不负责列表中提到的法国市场发行。 《鬼灭之刃剧场版：无限城第一章》作为三部曲首部，全球票房已达 7.93 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 53.05 亿元人民币） ，成为影史票房最高的动画电影之一，因此续集的上映时间自然备受关注。 相关阅读： 《 〈鬼灭之刃：无限城篇第一章〉剧场版动画电影 7 月 28 日上线流媒体，登陆 Crunchyroll 与 Netflix 》 《 “鬼灭”首登内地大银幕，动画电影〈鬼灭之刃：无限城篇第一章猗窝座再袭〉国内定档 11 月 14 日 》 《 卷均 956 万册历史第二：人气漫画〈鬼灭之刃〉全球累计发行量破 2 亿 》

科技.title: 特斯拉 App 适配苹果首款折叠 iPhone Duo，引入大屏双栏体验
科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，科技媒体 notateslaapp 今天（10 月 22 日）发布博文， 报道称特斯拉面向 iPad、iPhone Duo，推送 4.62.0 版本更新，重点针对大屏幕和折叠手机重新设计界面。 IT之家附上相关演示视频如下： 报道指出 iPad 用户此前只能使用被拉伸放大的 iPhone 版应用，而新版则采用专属大屏布局，左侧为功能菜单，右侧呈现更精细的车辆可视化界面，可同时查看更多车辆信息。 针对苹果折叠屏 iPhone Duo，应用在内屏采用大屏布局，可同时展示充电信息、实时摄像头和行车记录仪片段；合上手机后，外屏自动切换回常规手机界面。 新界面保留了手机版的核心功能，包括车辆控制、空调、位置、自动驾驶、召唤、充电、日程设置、安全与驾驶员管理以及安全评分等。用户打开“充电”等功能后，子菜单仍保留在左侧，详情内容则占据屏幕其余区域，操作层级更清晰。 新版还更新车辆可视化部分，更接近车内停车界面的效果，背景颜色会匹配车漆，地面还带有反射效果。用户可直接通过该界面开关前备箱、后备箱，锁止或解锁车辆，并查看充电状态。 特斯拉还新增了“自定义控制”入口，方便用户调整闪光、鸣笛、启动、通风等快捷按钮；新增的“显示 PSI”按钮则可将胎压直接显示在车辆可视化界面上，减少进入深层菜单的操作。

科技.title: 三星心系天下新品发布会定档 10 月 29 日，W27 系列折叠屏手机将至
科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，三星官方今日宣布，三星心系天下新品发布会定档 10 月 29 日 16:00 ，海报中出现了两款折叠屏手机的剪影。 据IT之家此前报道， 有三星授权体验店发布预告 ，心系天下 W27 新品发布会将于 10 月 29 日举行。消息显示，新机预计将于 11 月 5 日开启首批门店取机，高端旗舰折叠现开启优先预定。 按照以往惯例，三星 W27 心系天下手机预计基于 Galaxy Z Fold8 系列手机打造。三星 Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 手机于今年 7 月发布，起售价 14999 元。 作为参考，Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 配备一块 6.5 英寸 FHD+ 外屏，覆盖 Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3 玻璃。内屏为 8 英寸 QXGA+ 折叠屏，支持抗反射涂层，峰值亮度最高可达 3000 尼特。 ▲ Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 影像系统方面，Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 后置三摄，包括一颗 2 亿像素广角主摄（F1.7 光圈、支持 2 倍光学变焦）、一颗 5000 万像素超广角镜头（F2.2 光圈），以及一颗 1000 万像素长焦镜头（F2.4 光圈、支持 3 倍光学变焦）。内外屏分别配备一颗 1000 万像素前置摄像头。 性能方面，Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 搭载基于 3nm 工艺打造的第五代骁龙 8 至尊版（for Galaxy）处理器。存储组合包括 12GB+256GB、12GB+512GB 以及 16GB+1TB 三个版本。 续航方面，新机采用硅碳（Silicon-Carbon）电池，容量达到 5000mAh，支持 45W 有线快充和 20W 无线充电。

科技.title: 消息称苹果首款折叠 iPhone Duo 首销卖爆，12 个月内出货目标暴增 44%
科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，行业媒体 Digitimes 今天（10 月 22 日）发布博文，报道称基于供应链消息，苹果已将其首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 未来 12 个月的出货目标上调 44%， 由原定的 970 万部提高至 1400 万部。 报道显示，iPhone Duo 预购开始后不久， 部分市场的预计交付时间便已延后至 2027 年 1 月 ，显示早期订单规模显著超出备货水平。此次上调的直接原因，是该机自开启预购以来需求远超苹果预期，促使公司向供应链追加订单。 行业研究机构 IDC 此前预计，苹果首款折叠屏 iPhone 首年出货量将超过 1000 万部，并可能在 2027 年拿下全球折叠屏手机市场约 40% 的份额。高盛则维持对 iPhone Duo 的乐观判断，预计其 2026 年出货可达 1300 万部，2027 年有望达到 3300 万部。 Digitimes 指出出货目标上调并不等于最终销量，折叠屏机型的铰链、屏幕良率及复杂组装工艺仍可能制约产能，早期交付延迟，也说明苹果需要在需求、零部件供应与制造爬坡之间继续平衡。

科技.title: 微软员工数十年来首次下降；沃尔玛/山姆推出 Agent 购物接口；推动 SpaceX 和特斯拉合并，马斯克财富有望暴涨
科技.summary: 24 小时为你在线打工：Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet AI 智能体，迎战 Meta 和 OpenAI 10 月 22 日消息，Anthropic 昨日（10 月 21 日）宣布以研究预览版形式，推出全新应用 Claude Duet，定位为可主动工作的 AI 智能体（agent），加入由 Meta 的 Muse、以及 OpenAI 的 Dots 领衔的「全天候主动型 AI 助理」大战。 技能方面，该应用会每天整理跨应用的重要事项、主动提醒需要处理的问题，并在用户离开后继续在后台完成被委托的任务。 Claude Duet 基于 Claude Opus 5.5 构建，提供 iOS、Android 独立应用及 claude.ai 网页版。首批面向美国 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户开放候补名单；预览阶段与 Claude 其他功能共享套餐用量限制。（来源：IT 之家） Meta 2026 财年第三财季归母净利润 98.6 亿美元，同比增长 264% 10 月 22 日消息，Meta 发布 2026 财年（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 12 月）第三财季（2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）及本财年前三财季（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 9 月）报告。 2026 财年第三季度实现营收 646.01 亿美元，同比增长 26%；归母净利润 98.6 亿美元，同比增长 264%；稀释每股收益 3.83 美元，同比增长 265%。 核心业务 Family of Apps（Facebook、Instagram 等）营收达到 641.58 亿美元，运营利润 171.17 亿美元；Reality Labs（VR / AR 业务）营收 4.43 亿美元，运营亏损 41.29 亿美元，亏损同比收窄。（来源：IT 之家） 微软员工总数十年来首次下降，截至 6 月底雇员约 22.3 万人 10 月 22 日消息，微软已经在多个业务部门持续裁员一段时间，如今，一份年度报告披露了确切数据。 该公司最新年度申报文件显示，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，微软员工规模约为 22.3 万人，相比上一年的 22.8 万人有所减少，这是十年来微软员工总数首次出现下降。数据来自微软 2026 财年的 10-K 报表，文件写明公司拥有「约 22.3 万名全职员工」，其中美国本土 12.1 万人，海外 10.2 万人。 报告显示，产品研发部门受影响最大，员工人数从 2024 年峰值 8.1 万人降至 7.7 万人，连续第二年人员缩减；销售与营销岗位各减少 1000 个，现有 4.3 万人；综合行政岗位缩减至 1.4 万人。虽然员工总数下降，但微软 2026 财年营收上涨 18%，达到 3318 亿美元；仅 6 月所在季度，资本支出就达到 410 亿美元，公司正持续向人工智能数据中心投入大量资金。（来源：网易） 黄仁勋 GTC 柏林反驳 AI 终结软件论：工具公司将迎来更多使用者 10 月 21 日，英伟达创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋在 GTC 柏林大会上表示，AI 的发展将增加软件工具的使用者，工具公司也将向 AI 公司和智能体公司转型。 黄仁勋在演讲中提到，有人认为 AI 的到来意味着软件和工具公司的终结，他对此持相反看法。他认为，随着 AI 智能体承担更多工作，过去开发的软件工具将迎来更多使用者。 支撑这一判断的原因是，AI 要完成实际工作，仍然需要调用专业工具。黄仁勋以科学家和工程师的工作为例说明，即使具备很强的智能，也需要实验室、模拟器和求解工具。AI 智能体同样需要借助工具开展实验、仿真和数据处理。 他表示，编程是智能体较早落地的领域，编译器或 Python 环境就能支持其中一些任务。随着智能体进入更多行业，需要调用的工具也将更加丰富，包括流体力学、量子化学和工业设计软件。 按照黄仁勋的判断，工具公司未来将同时提供软件，以及经过专门优化、擅长使用这些软件的智能体。（来源：凤凰网） 沃尔玛开放 AI Agent 购物接口，第三方助手可直接搜索商品并完成交易 10 月 21 日，沃尔玛宣布推出 Walmart Agent Gateway，允许第三方 AI Agent 直接连接沃尔玛及 Sam』s Club 的购物系统。 通过这套接口，ChatGPT、Gemini、Muse 等 AI 助手可以在获得相应授权后，搜索商品并帮助用户完成购物。 沃尔玛还宣布将于下个月推出 Agent Profiles。用户可以为不同的 AI Agent 分别设置权限、消费额度，以及是否需要在每次购买前获得确认。 系统还会将 AI Agent 的购物记录与用户本人操作的订单区分开来，并允许用户随时撤销。（来源：路透） 英伟达推出模块化 AI 数据中心方案，宣称最快 14 天完成现场部署 10 月 21 日，英伟达在 GTC 柏林大会上推出 DSX POD，一套基于 Vera Rubin 平台的模块化 AI 数据中心参考设计。 与传统数据中心建设方式不同，DSX POD 将计算、网络、供电和液冷等系统预先集成在模块化容器中。 相关设备在工厂完成组装、布线和测试后，再整体运输至数据中心现场。 英伟达表示，在场地电力、冷却和网络等配套条件已经准备好的情况下，这种方式可以将现场部署周期从约六个月缩短至最快 14 天。 目前，包括戴尔、HPE、联想、施耐德电气和 Vertiv 在内的多家企业已经加入合作生态。 相关模块化 AI 数据中心预计于 2027 年初开始在全球交付。 推动 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并，马斯克财富有望增加 1100 亿美元 10 月 22 日消息，埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）在昨日 SpaceX 财报电话会议上引发舆论关注，他证实 SpaceX 与特斯拉公司已各自成立特别委员会，研究两家企业合并的可能性。 马斯克表示：「我们差不多正处在超级智能奇点阶段，双方合作能收获巨大价值。」 如果合并落地，马斯克本人也可能获得可观收益。彭博亿万富豪指数测算，若合并交易达成，特斯拉部分股份的归属期限将会提前，可为马斯克的财富增加逾 1100 亿美元，这批股份原本要到 2028 年才完成归属。 同时，根据交易中特斯拉的估值，他 2025 年的薪酬方案还能解锁更多价值数十亿美元的权益，而无需达成原本要求的经营目标才能拿到这笔报酬。 受合并谈判消息以及 SpaceX 亮眼的季度财报推动，两家公司股价上涨，马斯克的个人财富在周三暴涨超 600 亿美元。（来源：搜狐） EA 启动大规模重组：裁员 400 人《模拟人生》新项目被搁置 美国游戏发行商 EA（Electronic Arts）宣布新一轮业务重组计划，公司将裁减约 400 个工作岗位，约占全球员工总数的 3%。这一调整不仅涉及此前备受关注的 BioWare 关闭事件，还波及《模拟人生》《Skate》等多个知名游戏项目。 据曝光的内部备忘录显示，本轮裁员规模约为 400 人，其中大约 50 个岗位来自已经被取消的新《质量效应》项目开发团队。EA 管理层表示，此次决定是在对公司业务进行数月评估后作出的，希望将资源集中投入到更具战略意义的项目之中。 《模拟人生》系列同样受到影响。EA 已暂停代号为「Project Lotus」的开发计划，并将更多资源转移至另一项名为「Project Evergreen」的项目。尽管官方文件使用了「暂停」措辞，但多家媒体报道称，该项目实际上已经被取消。（来源：cnbeta） 经济学家估算《GTA6/侠盗猎车 6》发售或致美国 150 万人缺勤 经济学家 José García Montalvo 估算，《GTA6/侠盗猎车 6》发售当天可能有多达 150 万名美国员工为体验游戏而缺勤，生产力下降造成的潜在损失约为 10 亿美元。这项估算以 2026 年 11 月 19 日发售为前提，影响可能更多集中在 18 至 30 岁男性和科技行业。 作为参照，《侠盗猎车手 5》于 2013 年推出后，美国部分城市 18 至 35 岁员工中曾有多达 6% 请假，但《GTA6/侠盗猎车 6》的实际影响仍难以准确预测。加州 Burger Motorsports 已告知客户，由于部分员工为发售期安排休假，自 11 月 19 日起，其订单处理和支持速度可能放缓。 Newzoo 分析师还预测，《GTA6/侠盗猎车 6》首周销量至少可达 3700 万份，全球收入可达 45 亿美元。（来源：3DMGame） 亚特兰大拟禁止「机器警察」上岗，市议会一致支持限制武装机器人 美国佐治亚州亚特兰大市正试图提前阻止现实版「机械战警」出现。当地市议会近日一致通过一项名为「HALT 法案」（Human Authority over Lethal Technology，致命技术的人类控制权法案）的提案，计划禁止市政府采购或使用具备武装能力的自主机器人系统，确保涉及致命武力的决定始终由人类作出。 该法案由市议员莉莉安娜·巴赫蒂亚里提出。根据法案内容，亚特兰大市政府员工、承包商以及警察部门将被禁止采购、接收或部署配备武器的自主系统、无人机以及远程操控机器人。法案涵盖武装无人机、机器狗以及类似军事用途的机器人等设备，但用于拆除爆炸物的专用机器人不在限制范围之内。 巴赫蒂亚里表示，这项立法的目的并非反对科技发展，而是确保执法部门利用技术协助警员工作，而不是让机器取代警察作出关键决策。她认为，在致命武力使用问题上，必须始终保持人为控制，不能将相关决定交给人工智能系统。 推动这项法案的一个重要原因，是美国国防部近期宣布成立「自主作战司令部」（AutoWarCom），旨在加速自主和半自主作战系统的研发与部署。巴赫蒂亚里担心，原本用于军事领域的自主作战技术未来可能逐渐进入地方执法机构，因此有必要提前建立法律边界。（来源：新浪财经） 苹果 iPhone Duo 将于今年晚些时候支持「便捷访问」单手模式 苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 将在 10 月 23 日发售。《连线》杂志报道称，苹果计划于今年晚些时候，为这款手机推出「便捷访问」单手模式。 据报道，苹果计划为 iPhone Duo 加入新版「便捷访问」功能，让手比较小的用户只需要轻点屏幕，就能更轻松地触及屏幕左侧 / 右侧边缘。 「便捷访问」是苹果 iOS 系统的一项功能，最早于 2014 年随 iPhone 6、iPhone 6 Plus 一同推出，帮助用户单手操作手机时，更轻松地触及屏幕顶部区域。 在配备主屏幕按钮的 iPhone 上，只需要轻轻地轻点两下主屏幕按钮就能打开「便捷访问」；在配备面容 ID 的 iPhone 上，只需在屏幕底部边缘向下轻扫就能打开。（来源：IT 之家） Recursive 发布 Flint 编程模型：AI 参与几乎全部研发流程，40B 模型可在本地运行 10 月 21 日，由前 Salesforce 首席科学家 Richard Socher 创办的 Recursive⁠ 正式发布首款开放权重模型 Flint。 Flint 是一款面向编程 Agent 的混合专家模型，拥有约 398 亿总参数，但每个 Token 只激活约 25 亿参数。 模型主要面向代码库理解、Bug 修复、功能开发、测试编写和多轮工具调用等任务。 Recursive 表示，Flint 的开发过程大量依赖公司内部的自动化 AI 研究系统 Eureka Machine。 从训练方法、模型架构，到针对特定芯片优化的代码，AI 都参与了研发和改进。 公司称，一个规模很小的研究团队，在不到四个月的时间里完成了模型开发。 Flint 已经以 Apache 2.0 许可证开放权重。公司提供针对 NVIDIA 和 Apple Silicon 的量化版本，以支持不同硬件环境下的本地推理。 在 Recursive 公布的测试中，Flint 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上取得 54.9% 的成绩。不过，不同模型的测试设置存在差异，相关性能优势仍需要独立验证。 美航空航天局公布月球车最新研发进展及任务规划 美国航空航天局当地时间 20 日公布了其月球车的最新研发进展及任务规划。用于探测月球水资源的「挥发物调查极地探索车」（VIPER）计划于 2027 年运抵月球南极地区开展探测，载人月球地形车则计划于 2028 年前运抵月球南极地区，为未来载人探月和月球基地建设提供支持。 美航空航天局表示，VIPER 月球车目前处于休斯敦的约翰逊航天中心，已完成组装，正在进行最终测试。该月球车计划于 2027 年由美国蓝色起源公司研制的着陆器运送至月球表面，收集有关月球南极地区的温度、光照条件和地形等数据。这些数据有助于科学家进一步了解月球水资源的来源与分布，评估月球资源未来用于月球基地建设的潜力。 此外，美航空航天局授予美航天实验室公司和美「月球前哨」公司相关合同，推进首批载人月球地形车研发。两家公司计划于 2027 年年底前向美航空航天局交付载人月球地形车，并计划于 2028 年由蓝色起源公司送往月球南极地区。 据介绍，载人月球地形车可由地面人员远程操控，在宇航员抵达前开展月面测绘，帮助科学家绘制高精度地图，并收集光照、导航等数据。根据设计指标，车辆每天最多可行驶约 6 公里，单次充电后的行驶里程最多可达 10 公里，并可运输最多约 80 公斤月球样本和工具。未来执行「阿耳忒弥斯」载人登月任务时，宇航员将驾驶月球车探索月球南极地区，采集地质样本并带回地球。（来源：央视）

科技.title: 我用 iPhone Duo 刷小红书、淘宝、飞书，发现作用不只是装「阔」
科技.summary: 头图图片来源：极客公园 我在 iPhone Duo 上，把淘宝、高德、小红书、腾讯视频、飞书、WPS、XMind，还有篮球游戏 NBA 巅峰对决，这 8 个为它做过适配的 App 挨个用了一遍。淘宝从首页到客服消息，整条购物链路都动过；高德把路线和地图拆成了左右两半；小红书的笔记，变成了左边看图、右边看正文和评论。 这台手机的国行首批预订已经售罄。据环球时报 10 月 17 日的报道，苹果官网显示的预计交付时间，排到了明年二月，等货的这几个月，其实大家最关心答案的问题只有一个： 除了更「阔」，它和我们用了这么多年的直板 iPhone，体验到底有什么不一样。 对 iPhone 来讲答案是，合上的时候，它最像一台普通 iPhone，区别只是程序坞、状态栏和灵动岛挪到了屏幕侧边，竖着排。真正的不同发生在另外两种状态里：完全展开，App 会把一屏分成左右两栏；半折立在桌上，上半屏用来看，下半屏用来操作。 内屏分成两栏 淘宝是这次改得最全的一个。直板 iPhone 上看一件商品，是先看头图，再往下滑看标题和详情。Duo 展开后，主图在左，标题、价格和详情在右，边看图边看描述。合着的时候也改了，详情页的头图比例调过，一屏能同时看到两张图和标题、价格。 首页和搜索结果可以双指捏合，在两列到四列之间调，想看大图就放大，想一屏多看几件就缩小。购物车里能看到完整的商品标题和优惠信息。 改得最实用的是消息页。左边是商家列表，右边是聊天窗口。一次要跟好几家店问尺码、问发货，在直板 iPhone 上，每换一家都得退回列表再点进去；在 Duo 上，左边点一下，右边就换了一家。 淘宝还有两个新功能在测，AI 试穿和试妆，目前在灰度阶段，只有测试版入口能用。上传一张自己的半身或全身照，右边挑上衣、裤子、鞋和帽子，淘宝的说法是一件衣服一分钟内出效果；试妆直接用前置摄像头。不过试穿本身跟折叠屏关系不大，大屏给它的是右边那块挑衣服的地方。 淘宝针对横屏场景优化的 AI 试穿效果｜图片来源：极客公园 对日常使用直屏手机习惯的用户来讲，在 iPhone Duo 上平时随手下单，合上用就够了。双十一要比价、要跟几家客服来回问的那几天，才是它最该展开的时候。 在出门这件事上，高德改版之后的优势最为明显。在直板 iPhone 上查一条路线，屏幕上是几条方案排成一列，能比较的只有时间和距离；这条路现在堵不堵、终点附近好不好停车，得点进去，再把地图放大缩小看一遍。 在 Duo 上展开，左边是路线方案和预计用时，右边是整张地图，起点附近的路况、终点的停车场和加油站都在上面。 打车也一样，左边是行程信息，右边一直显示那辆车开到了哪。扫街榜则是左边榜单、右边地图，附近哪家店分高、离自己多远，同时就能看到。 开车导航这次是高德针对 iPhone Duo 体验适配的重点：高德放了一段路测视频，演示的是双视野模式：左半屏是车道级导航，告诉你该走哪条车道、什么时候并线；右半屏是一张往前看三到五公里的地图。高德团队的说法是，开车时在单屏上放大缩小、点全览本身就危险，两种视角同时摆着，就不用再伸手。 双视野导航效果｜图片来源：高德 另一项是分屏：左边开聊天软件，朋友在群里发来餐厅定位，点一下，右边的高德就弹出这家店，直接发起导航。这两项目前都只有视频演示，要等后续版本更新。 高德地图针对 iPhone Duo 开发的功能：将高德地图内的地点快速分享到对话中｜图片来源：极客公园 这里 iPhone Duo 需要回答的问题是，类似横屏设备本来就能分屏，为什么还要专门适配？高德团队的解释是，这牵涉跨 App 传递信息。系统分屏只是让两个 App 同时摆出来，要让聊天里的一个定位直接变成右边的导航，得 App 自己去接。这是直板 iPhone 上从来没有过的一种区别，也是目前做得最少的一种。 上班的场景里，直板 iPhone 一直有三个别扭的地方：表格得拖来拖去才能看全，对比两个版本要在文件之间来回切，打字时键盘挡掉半屏。 WPS 展开后，左边是侧栏、中间是正文，布局几乎就是电脑版，很多表格展开后能一屏看完。 改过的文档和原稿可以并排打开，一起滑动对照，哪里的金额改了，一眼就能看出来。WPS 的智能助理原来是从底部拉出来的抽屉，会挡住正文，现在改成左右分栏，一边看建议一边改。 飞书把看和聊放到了一起。同事发来一段视频，可以分屏，上面看、下面聊，界面还会跟着折叠角度调整；会后用妙记回看，左边是会议视频，右边是文字记录和纪要。 飞书在 iPhone Duo 上的适配效果｜图片来源：极客公园 飞书在 iPhone Duo 外屏的演示效果｜图片来源：极客公园 XMind 让大纲和思维导图并排出现，也能同时打开两个文件，一个当参考，一个接着整理。 XMind 针对 iPhone Duo 优化的显示界面｜图片来源：极客公园 立在桌上的新角度 差别最大的是追剧。直板 iPhone 看剧，要么竖着看小画面，要么横过来全屏，进度条和弹幕输入框都叠在画面上，而且得一直拿在手里。Duo 多了一种姿势：半折，立在桌上。 腾讯视频在这个状态下，把视频集中到上半屏，下半屏是精简过的操作区，拖进度、截图、发弹幕都在下面完成，发弹幕时画面不会被遮住。从合着的状态把它支成一个小帐篷，就能全屏播放。 腾讯视频在 iPhone Duo 内屏/外屏不同摆放方式下的播放效果｜图片来源：极客公园 上周库克来中国时，专程抽时间去了一趟爱奇艺，看的也是类似的交互设计；10 月 14 日，已经卸任 CEO、现任苹果执行董事长的库克到访爱奇艺北京总部，爱奇艺给他演示的就是手机半折，上半屏放片，下半屏调进度、倍速、画质和弹幕。库克随后发文，称赞了这款应用的优化。 小红书的变化在刷内容上。外屏还是熟悉的双列，展开后一屏能看到更多笔记。 小红书将功能菜单移动到了屏幕右侧底部｜图片来源：极客公园 点进一篇，图片在左，正文和评论在右，不用看完图再往下翻评论。看视频笔记时，合上手机，外屏会接着播；微折放在桌上，视频在上，评论在下，互动不挡画面。 小红书横屏显示布局效果｜图片来源：极客公园 对折叠屏适配优化而言，游戏也是同一个思路。NBA 巅峰对决半折时，上面是完整的比赛画面，下面是操作区，球员数据直接显示在操作区里，不用暂停、另开一个页面去查，开发者的形容是像在玩掌机。 NBA 游戏在 iPhone Duo 竖屏下显示效果｜图片来源：极客公园 WPS 则把这种姿势留给了输入：半折时，下半屏是一整块键盘；录音转文字时，上面滚动显示文字，下面是录音状态。 看剧、刷小红书、打游戏这些传统娱乐体验，是 Duo 离直板手机最远的地方。腾讯视频和小红书都说，23 日上架的版本会比这次的体验版更完整。 和直板 iPhone 比，Duo 的区别不在合上的时候，而在三种用法：展开分两栏，半折立在桌上，两个 App 并排。 虽然在 iPhone Duo 的首发时刻，大家先记住的，多半还会是 iPhone Duo 那块能展开的屏幕，这很正常，它一眼就能看见。但相信随着首发的狂热逐渐过去，问题的重点还是会逐渐回归到同样值得说的是另一半：App 开始重新想，这么大一块屏幕该怎么用。 每个 App 交出的答案，都不一样。同样是半折，腾讯视频拿下半屏发弹幕，NBA 巅峰对决拿它看球员数据，WPS 拿它当键盘，XMind 想的是让学生把待办清单立在桌上。苹果在 iOS 27 里，连铰链开合的角度都开放给了开发者，App 能实时读到手机此刻折到了多少度。 目前，这显然还只是应用大厂们在 iPhone Duo 这个平台上给出的第一批答案。等更多 App 想出自己的用法，折叠屏比的就不只是谁的屏幕更大了。
